interface.name: zwp_primary_selection_device_manager_v1
interface.description: The primary selection device manager is a singleton global object that provides access to the primary selection.

request.name: create_source

description.summary: create a new primary selection source

request.description: Create a new primary selection source.

request.name: get_device

description.summary: create a new primary selection device

request.description: Create a new data device for a given seat.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: destroy the primary selection device manager

request.description: Destroy the primary selection device manager.

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: serial of the event that triggered this request

event.name: data_offer
event.description: Introduces a new wp_primary_selection_offer object that may be used to receive the current primary selection.

event.name: selection
event.description: The wp_primary_selection_device.selection event is sent to notify the client of a new primary selection.

request.name: receive

description.summary: request that the data is transferred

request.description: To transfer the contents of the primary selection clipboard, the client issues this request and indicates the mime type that it wants to receive.

event.name: offer
event.description: Sent immediately after creating announcing the wp_primary_selection_offer through wp_primary_selection_device.data_offer.

request.name: offer
request.description: This request adds a mime type to the set of mime types advertised to targets.

event.name: send
event.description: Request for the current primary selection contents from the client.

event.name: cancelled

description.summary: request for primary selection contents was canceled

event.description: This primary selection source is no longer valid.
